title: ReportIndexDocumentDeletedPayload
description: report.index_document.deleted v1 (OpenVibe.Report server/search-index.js, via openvibe-publishing/search-feed). A Search tombstone for a Rundown topic page that left the Rundown. Only sent for a page Search was sent before. Consumed by OpenVibe.Search ('*.index_document.*'). Envelope: subject { type, id, revision }, visibility internal, actor service:report.

revision.description: Index revision of the tombstone; wins over any document at the same or an older revision.
